spec.title: Nocturne for Closed Curtains
spec.intent: A quiet nocturnal jazz chamber study in which piano and bass clarinet pass a breath-like motif above sustained cello shadows, gradually contracting into a whispered ending.

tempo.feel: Slow pulse-based 4/4 with barely audible frame-drum emphasis and generous rubato at phrase endings.

instrumentation.name: piano
instrumentation.role: Introduces the main motif and provides sparse modal harmony.
instrumentation.timbre: Soft, close, lightly felted attack with spacious voicings.

instrumentation.name: bass clarinet
instrumentation.role: Echoes and reshapes the piano melody in a lower, breath-like register.
instrumentation.timbre: Warm, woody, intimate, with restrained legato phrasing.

instrumentation.name: cello
instrumentation.role: Sustains shadow tones and gradually deepens the harmonic atmosphere.
instrumentation.timbre: Muted arco, dark and smooth, with long gentle releases.

instrumentation.name: soft frame drum
instrumentation.role: Provides a barely audible pulse and subtle phrase punctuation.
instrumentation.timbre: Muted fingertip touches, sparse and organic.

structure.direction: Nearly free piano introduces isolated fragments of the motif over silence; keep the room intimate and the dynamics very low.
Bass clarinet answers the piano in imitation. Add sustained cello pedal tones, parallel sixths, and delayed modal resolutions; frame drum enters only as a faint pulse.
Let piano and bass clarinet overlap more closely while cello lengthens the shadow tones. Increase density slightly without increasing volume, then thin the texture.
Reduce piano and bass clarinet to a shared unison whisper, with cello fading beneath them and the final harmony remaining gently unresolved.

spec.production: Tactile acoustic chamber recording in a small, dim room; close piano and bass clarinet, cello slightly behind them, soft natural reverberation, restrained dynamics, clear silence between phrases, and a warm low-register stereo image.
assumptions: Targeted 56 BPM to support the slow pulse and 105-second arc.
Used an unspecified tonic to preserve the veiled modal character.
spec.lyriaPrompt: Late-night noir jazz chamber piece for relaxation, approximately 105 seconds, slow 56 BPM pulse in 4/4 with generous rubato at phrase endings. Modal minor harmony with pedal tones, parallel sixths, suspended color, and delayed resolutions; keep the tonal center veiled. [Intro] Soft intimate piano presents a breath-like motif in sparse, spacious voicings. [Development] Warm bass clarinet echoes and reshapes the motif in a lower register while muted arco cello sustains dark shadow tones; add a barely audible soft frame-drum pulse. [Contraction] Let piano and bass clarinet overlap in closer imitation, increasing density without increasing volume, then gradually remove layers. [Outro] Contract to a fragile shared unison whisper with fading cello and a gently unresolved final harmony. Tactile acoustic chamber recording, small dim room, close foreground detail, warm low-register stereo image, natural reverberation, restrained dynamics, and meaningful silence between phrases. Instrumental only, no vocals. Avoid bright aggression, virtuoso playing, heavy percussion, abrupt transitions, loud climaxes, and emphatic cadence.
